7.heading: swear:
refs: Heb. lift up the hand, Gen 14:22
Princes and great men in the East, as Sir J. Chardin testifies, are obliged to have a great stock of clothes in readiness for presents on all occasions

and a great quantity of provisions for the table is equally necessary - see 1Ki 4:22-23 ,. Neh 5:17-18 ,. Hence the person desired to undertake the government, alleges as an excuse that he is not able to support the dignity of his station.
